name: Forte Metals
verdict: The biggest movement this period is a 54.55% drop in Google Business Profile engagement over the last 7 days (vs. prior 7 days), alongside a 53.33% decline in Search Console activity, suggesting a likely pullback in organic local search visibility. With zero spend, leads, or clicks recorded across Meta and Google Ads in the full 28-day window, all lead generation activity is currently dependent on unpaid channels that are trending sharply downward.

performance.verdict: Organic collapse is real; paid is absent — no floor to stand on.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days; 0 Meta clicks, 0 Google Ads clicks. All lead generation is undefended — no paid floor exists.
3 overdue CRM milestones predate Aug: 1st Directives (Jul 7), Tom call list (Jul 28), dedup workbook (Jul 31) — no completion event recorded.
3 Aug-31 blockers unresolved: 342 stubs unreconciled, Web/SEO root cause unfiled, AGS+Forte contact pull missing — all gate downstream work.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for 4 straight days (Aug 29–Sep 2) after averaging ~4.5/day Aug 6–28; 3-day signal confirms the drop is not noise.
Search Console clicks fell to 0–1/day over last 5 days vs a prior peak of 5 on Aug 25; 54% 7d delta corroborates the organic visibility pullback.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 3 Aug-31 SOW blockers immediately — 342 stubs, SEO root cause, and contact pull — each gates revenue-facing work.
suggestions.monday_update: Three confirmed blockers missed the Aug 31 deadline: (1) 342 stub accounts unreconciled — Sales-i sync is blind to these accounts until fixed; (2) Web/SEO root cause not filed — organic visibility has dropped 54% in 7 days; (3) AGS + Forte contact pull not delivered — cold outreach cannot launch. Assign owners and post status updates to Monday by Sep 5. Success: all three items show a completion event or a dated action plan by Sep 5.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP 4-day zero streak — check for listing suspension or NAP change that broke local pack visibility.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for Aug 29–Sep 2 after averaging ~4.5 actions/day across the prior 23 days — a confirmed signal, not noise. Search Console clicks confirm parallel organic collapse (5 clicks Aug 25 → 0 by Sep 2). Check Google Business Profile for suspension flags, ownership challenges, or NAP edits made around Aug 28. Success: GBP actions return to ≥3/day within 7 days of fix; recheck Sep 10.

suggestions.text: Watch Jul 7 and Jul 28 CRM milestones for completion evidence; resurface as escalation if still open by Sep 10.
